proof_body:
by
  intro x n hx
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 * Real.sin (x / 2) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, Real.sin (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = Real.cos (x / 2) - Real.cos (((m : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero, Nat.cast_zero]
      rw [show ((0 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x = x / 2 by ring]
      ring
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ih]
      push_cast
      have h := Real.cos_sub_cos (((m : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) (((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1 / 2) * x)
      have e1 : (((m : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x + ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1 / 2) * x) / 2 = ((m : ℝ) + 1) * x := by ring
      have e2 : (((m : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x - ((m : ℝ) + 1 + 1 / 2) * x) / 2 = -(x / 2) := by ring
      rw [e1, e2, Real.sin_neg] at h
      linarith
  have hs : 0 < |Real.sin (x / 2)| := abs_pos.2 hx
  have h1 : |2 * Real.sin (x / 2) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x)| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [key]
    exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [Real.neg_one_le_cos (x / 2), Real.cos_le_one (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x)], by linarith [Real.cos_le_one (x / 2), Real.neg_one_le_cos (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x)]⟩
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)] at h1
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ), Real.sin (x / 2) ≠ 0 → |∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x)| ≤ 1 / |Real.sin (x / 2)|
